label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 76
title: MVP: telemetry + metrics view (JSON telemetry + Prometheus /metrics scrape target)
body:
Dashboard telemetry/metrics page showing token/cost/latency per tenant/user/project/stage/agent/model (JSON telemetry) and exposing the /metrics scrape endpoint for Prometheus/Grafana. Extends BI-0033 (FinOps) and the observability NFR.

ADDITIONAL FIELDS (folded from BI-0086 - genuinely new; see merge note):
- prefix_cache_hit_rate: provider prompt-cache hit % (share of prompt tokens served from the provider's prompt cache) per agent/stage.
- assembly_ms: context assembly time in milliseconds (time to build the prompt/context package) per agent/stage.
